content:
It's time to look at the latest iPhone 18 Pro phone cases. Apple's newest products officially started accepting pre-orders this morning, and several major brands are ready to go. Apple has launched a series of colourful silicone cases, along with brand-new TechWoven fabric cases, as well as a range of evergreen styles from major third-party manufacturers. From a new burgundy version with a built-in stand, to highly customisable models with excellent grip, to premium leather from brands like Nomad and Burton Goods, there's something for everyone. Brands like Spigen also offer budget-friendly options starting at US$14.

Best iPhone 18 Pro Cases

Featured Pick: ESR

ESR's brand-new range of iPhone 18 Pro cases and accessories is officially here, featuring premium colourways, patented technology and more. The standout is the all-new Atelier Vegan Leather MagSafe Case, which comes with a built-in zinc-alloy Flex stand that seamlessly integrates with the camera bump for added protection, claims to offer 3x military-grade protection, and is "soft, bouncy and comfortable to the touch." The new Atelier range comes in four colourways, with other accessories to perfectly match the new Wine Red, Glacier, Black and Silver iPhone 18 Pro models.

  • ESR Atelier Vegan Leather MagSafe Case with Flex Stand: US$42 (was US$46) | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR UltraFit Armorite Pro Screen Protector: US$30 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Cyber FlickLock MagSafe Case: US$21 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Geo MagSafe Card Wallet Stand with Non-Slip Grip: US$46 (was US$50) | Amazon or ESR

Nomad

Nomad is a renowned premium leather case brand, and cases for all iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max flagship models are now ready. This year, the brand has also launched a brand-new Rugged Case range, with each colourway featuring contour textures inspired by the Baja California Peninsula:

  • Rugged Case: US$70
  • Colours: Norte, Balandra, Arroyo
  • Clear Leather: US$69
  • Colours: Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black
  • Magnetic Leather Back: US$59
  • Colours: Burgundy, Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black, Olde Dublin
  • Sport Case: US$55
  • Colours: Black, Driftwood, Rosewood, Lunar Grey
  • Modern Leather Case: US$69 to US$89
  • Traditional Leather Case: US$79 to US$99
  • Rugged Leather Case: US$79
  • Colours: Rustic Brown

Featured Pick: Dbrand

Dbrand's popular Grip Case is ready for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. In addition to having one of the cleanest designs on the market and an extremely grippy texture, this year it continues to fully support a variety of customisable skin stickers so you can add personal flair; pair it with a corresponding Prism screen protector for a discount.

  • Dbrand Grip Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max): US$55. Customisable, drop-resistant, ultra-grippy, with excellent button feel.
  • Dbrand Prism 2.0 (iPhone 18 Pro/Max), 2-pack: US$35 (save US$5 when purchased with the case). Easy install, auto-alignment, fully dust-free.

Dbrand has also launched a brand-new MNML case range this year, starting from US$39, offering minimalist, stylish designs at affordable prices, with MagSafe support while retaining the brand's signature crisp button feel.

  • Dbrand MNML iPhone 18 Pro/Max Case: US$39. Colours: Black, Marine, Tan, Burgundy.

  • Matte Black — US$69.99

MUJJO Troubadour

  • Full Leather Case (iPhone 18 Series): US$59
  • Colours: Black, Basalt, Obsidian Green, Tan, Terracotta
  • Modular Case (iPhone 18 Series): US$59
  • Detachable magnetic backplate lets you switch between two modes. With the backplate attached: full-grain leather case, slim design with MagSafe support.

Burton Goods

***Note: Enter our exclusive code 9TO520 at checkout for an additional 20% off the already reduced launch price (applies to the cases below). If the code doesn't work, try DUO10.

  • Heritage Leather Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max): US$60 (was US$80)
  • Luxury Pocket Book Folio (iPhone 18 Pro/Max): US$89 (was US$119)
  • Heritage Leather Case (iPhone 18 Duo): US$60 (was US$80)

UAG

UAG has also released several cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, including their signature reinforced corners, non-slip edges, and rugged models with various drop-protection designs. If you're looking for a case that can withstand harsh environments while still being suitable for everyday protection, the UAG range is well worth a look.

  • UAG Mouve (iPhone Duo): US$65
  • EGO TACTICAL UAG Urban Armor Gear Pathfinder Case (iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max): US$80
  • UAG Civilian Grip Case: from US$60
  • More…

YETI iPhone 18 Pro/18 Pro Max Case

If you're looking for a rugged case for your new iPhone but don't want to go with common brands like OtterBox or UAG, YETI's LoadOut range is well worth considering. These cases have passed the MIL-STD-810H drop test, provide reliable protection, support MagSafe, and feature a built-in rotating stand for hands-free use.

Mous

If you're looking for a premium iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max case that doesn't make your phone look too bulky, Mous is a strong contender. Mous now offers ultra-thin aramid fibre cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, as well as the models below.

  • Mous Limitless MagSafe Case: US$75
  • Mous Clear Case: US$70
  • Mous Limitless Aramid Fibre Case: US$85
  • Mous Slim MagSafe Case: US$55
  • Mous Slim Aramid Fibre Case: US$70
  • More…

Aulumu

AULUMU's iPhone 18 Pro cases are known for futuristic designs, avant-garde styling and slim profiles, standing out from the crowd with unique texture finishes.

  • Aulumu A18 Ultra-Thin Aramid Fibre Case: US$66
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop Protection Case (iPhone 18 Pro): US$60
  • Aulumu A18 Frosted Case: US$40

Pitaka

PITAKA cases are ideal for iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max users who prioritise ultra-thin design. Their products are typically made from lightweight aramid fibre, with a clean, understated look, while maintaining MagSafe compatibility and providing extra protection around the camera and edges.

  • Pitaka Edge Aramid Fibre Texture Case: US$60
  • Pitaka Summa Military-Grade Drop Protection Aramid Case: US$80
  • Pitaka Cairn Rugged Protection Case: US$60

OtterBox iPhone 18 Pro Series Cases

OtterBox also offers a diverse range of cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, from slim everyday models to heavy-duty rugged designs with reliable protection. Many new models support MagSafe, and some add grippier sides, accessory card slots, raised camera protection and built-in stands, so you can choose based on your preferred thickness and level of protection.

  • OtterBox Defender Series Pro: US$70
  • OtterBox Commuter Series: US$50
  • OtterBox Symmetry Series with Stand: US$60
  • OtterBox Sole Series: US$60
  • More…

Belkin

Belkin is another solid choice for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, particularly for users who prefer a clean style, don't want their phone to become too bulky, but don't need a fully rugged-grade case. Their range typically includes MagSafe-compatible clear and protective cases with raised screen and camera edges, while some models (such as the Protect+) feature reinforced corners, striking a good balance between everyday protection and slim design.

  • Belkin Clear MagSafe Case: US$30
  • Belkin Qi2-compatible MagSafe Case with Non-Slip Grip: US$50
  • Belkin Protect+ Case with Air Cushion Corners: US$60
